notes:
[Verifier 2026-10-05] DOE loan restructured: the DOE project page and the S-1/A give a facility of up to $1.52B (LGA dated 2024-07-31, FFB lends, DOE guarantees); USAspending's Loan Value $1,450,241,177 differs (kept as evidence only; possibly principal excl. capitalized interest, note 1 allows $132.0M capitalized interest). The facility is now a ceiling (not counted); the money actually drawn (about $1.0B of FFB advances by 2026-06-30, per S-1/A) is recorded as its own new_money event. Borrower is Holtec Palisades, LLC, a subsidiary project company; the S-1/A consolidates it and describes the advances as received by 'we/us', so it is treated as group funding. Gap: the S-1/A also mentions a $300.0M State of Michigan grant deposited into the restart account (not recorded). Original notes follow. Private company; no priced equity rounds are disclosed in the sources reached (the S-1 describes the IPO only; S-1 financing history sections were not mined). Two events: (1) DOE loan guarantee/loan to Holtec Palisades LLC (a Holtec subsidiary project company for the Palisades restart), USAspending Loan Value USD1,450,241,177, subsidy cost USD18,058,475.02, issued 2024-07-31 (DOE record of decision page dated 2024-07-31 archived; it gives no amount). The amount in USAspending is the loan value of that award; DOE's own headline figure may differ (not evidenced here). (2) IPO of Holtec Nuclear Corporation (Nasdaq HNUC, CIK 2104277): confidential DRS 2026-01-30, public S-1 2026-07-10, S-1/A 2026-09-08 for 50,000,000 Class A shares at an expected USD15-18 (net proceeds about USD775.2M at USD16.50 midpoint), then WITHDRAWN: Form RW filed 2026-09-25 states no securities were issued or sold. No amount is entered on the IPO event so it is not counted as funding. Not recorded because not evidenced by an archived primary source: NJ EDA USD260M tax incentive (2014, Wikipedia/press only), UK government GBP30M for SMR-300 (Telegraph, 2023), DOE Environmental Management contracts to Holtec Government Services (USAspending shows USD106M of transactions since FY2020; contracts, not financing), Hyundai/other partnerships. Canada G&C, CORDIS, TED and BODACC probes have no Holtec records.
MERGE 2026-10-05 (USAspending supplement): the four DOE assistance awards are to Holtec Government Services LLC, which is treated as a Holtec group operating subsidiary (not a project SPV); the ARDP description names the beneficiary ('HOLTEC INTERNATIONAL IS DESIGNING THE SMR-160') and DE-NE0008843 concerns the SMR-160, but the ownership link is not evidenced in our snapshots (UNCERTAIN, review). The consent-based siting grant is spent-fuel siting outreach, not reactor development. USAspending 'Total Outlays' is account-level outlay data reported from FY2017/FY2020 onward, so disbursed_usd can understate payments on older awards.
